scope: Syntax-checked source metadata without implicit runtime facilities

reference_basis.documented: ALPHABETIZE creates/displays static variables alphabetically; COMMENT is a quoted program attribute up to 16 characters before CONST/TYPE/VAR; ENVIRONMENT selects translator definition files
reference_basis.uncertainty: No authenticated native duplicate precedence, full environment-path grammar or environment visibility emulation

implementation_choices.environment: Record bare ASCII letter-starting names of 1..36 characters in uppercase; repeated/custom names preserved; no file or module loading, definitions or implicit built-ins
implementation_choices.comment: One decoded ASCII literal up to 16 characters before all declaration sections and routines; empty text allowed; duplicate attributes rejected
implementation_choices.scanning: Recognize doubled apostrophes and quote boundaries before stripping a real trailing comment or detecting unsupported continuation; raw token text retained
implementation_choices.alphabetize: Record display request without reordering offline storage, snapshots or declarations
implementation_choices.placement: Line-ending top-level directives after PROGRAM and before BEGIN; ENVIRONMENT and ALPHABETIZE also allowed between declaration sections; no routine-local or executable directives
implementation_choices.reports: Raw directives plus source-located directive_metadata and current directive_policy; deduplicated required_environments in first-use order
implementation_choices.generated: Immutable normalized name/argument tuple pairs in Program.source_directives, independent of mutable report dictionaries

retained_boundaries: Unknown/runtime directives, INCLUDE, persistence, scheduling, task/group and device-default mappings remain blocked
Every source symbol, call and type checked independently; no environment-based grants or native visibility/default-file emulation
No controller attribute writes or native/compiler/controller acceptance claim; strict remains future work
